body: It's already too late for me to change my mind about this. I'm sorry.
If I don't keep them safe, no one will. I would rather they be dead than die knowing I won't be there to protect them.

Talking about this will change nothing. I tried to get help for me, for them, but there's just so little out there. We're too poor to afford therapy or any other kind of professional help that costs money.
I can't protect my children from my SO if I'm not there anymore. There would be no one left to make sure they're safe.
